label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter 'BlCurated00040' flows directly into bar via replace("\"", """). While this escapes HTML entity quotes, it fails to encode other dangerous characters like <, >, &, which allows XSS payloads such as '<script>alert(1)</script>' to bypass the filter and execute in the browser.

evidence.note: Parameter read from request and weakly sanitized (only quote escaping), then concatenated into HTML attribute allowing script execution
